Wait, the build has only shown "Building xPlanBox [1/61]" which is the root aggregator. The warnings are about reactor dependencies which is normal. But it's been 13 minutes (started 09:43, now 09:56) and still at module 1. That's the root pom which mostly does dependency resolution for the whole reactor.

Actually, the "Building xPlanBox [1/61]" is the root project. The reactor first resolves ALL dependencies for the entire build. With `-ntp` and 61 modules, this initial resolution can take a while but 13 minutes is a lot. Let me check if it's actually downloading or stuck on a single long connection.

Let me check the java process and whether the m2 repo is still growing.

action.command: echo "=== CPU of java (pid 2454) over 15s ==="; TOP1=$(ps -o %cpu= -p 2454 2>/dev/null); sleep 15; TOP2=$(ps -o %cpu= -p 2454 2>/dev/null); echo "cpu was:$TOP1 now:$TOP2"; echo "=== m2 size now ==="; du -sh /root/.m2/repository 2>/dev/null; echo "=== network connections from java ==="; ss -tnp 2>/dev/null | grep 2454 | wc -l; echo "=== open sockets detail ==="; ss -tnp 2>/dev/null | grep java | head -5
